How We Work

A process built for quality work.

We visit the property, evaluate the surfaces, and understand the scope of work. You receive a clear written estimate with labor, materials, and schedule.

  • Free estimate
  • Written estimate
  • Clear scope

This is where the real difference is made: protecting floors and furniture, repairing cracks, patching, and sanding. Proper preparation is what separates good painting from average work.

  • Surface protection
  • Patching & sanding
  • Crack repair

Coats applied to the manufacturer's specification, daily inspection by the lead painter, and the space left clean at the end of every day.

  • Correct coats
  • Daily inspection
  • Clean worksite

A final walkthrough side by side with you, with immediate touch-ups where needed. We only close out the job once you approve.

  • Joint walkthrough
  • Immediate touch-ups
  • Final approval
